FAQ

Ordering in Norcross

Do you deliver to Norcross?

Yes. We deliver to Norcross from our Duluth kitchen at 2148 Duluth Hwy 120, Suite 117, Duluth, GA. You can order direct from us or through the delivery apps — direct costs less.

Is there halal food in Norcross?

Bite More serves 100% halal Italian-American food to Norcross — smash burgers, pasta, wings and loaded fries. Every protein is halal at both of our kitchens.

What time do you close?

Buckhead: 11am–12am Mon–Wed, 11am–1am Thursday, 11am–3am Friday and Saturday, 11am–1am Sunday. Duluth: 11am–9pm Mon–Wed, 11am–11pm Thu–Sun.

Can I pick up instead?

Yes. Order ahead and collect from our Duluth location at 2148 Duluth Hwy 120, Suite 117.
